review.why: Three-stage workflow to co-author docs, specs and proposals, ending with a test by a fresh reader.
review.summary: Guides the user through context gathering, section-by-section drafting (questions, brainstorm, curate, gap check, draft, refine) and reader testing with a fresh model that has no context. Edits are surgical (never reprint the whole document) and the user keeps the final read-through.
strengths: Reader testing with a fresh model catches blind spots
Clear per-section loop with numbered options to keep or cut
Surgical edits only, and the user owns the final review
cautions: Long interactive process, slow for a short document
Relies on connectors or sub-agents when they exist
